clues: Neither the mortarboard nor the owl went on the carrot cake.
The carrot and coconut cakes went to Elsa and Gus, in some order.
Jade's cake was either lemon or carrot.
The star topper went on either the chocolate or the lemon cake.
Neither Tariq nor Gus picked the mortarboard.
Tariq's topper was either the owl or the diploma.
hints: Look at the carrot cake in the box where flavors meet toppers. Which toppers could it possibly have?
Clue 1 crosses off two toppers for the carrot cake, and clue 4 says the star went on chocolate or lemon. Put them together.
So the carrot cake had the diploma topper. Clue 2 keeps Jade off the carrot cake, so by clue 3 she ordered the lemon cake.

solution.key_idea: Clues 1 and 4 together leave the carrot cake only the diploma topper.
steps: Clue 1 rules out the mortarboard and owl for the carrot cake, and clue 4 the star, so the carrot cake had the diploma.
By clue 2, the carrot and coconut cakes went to Elsa and Gus, so by clue 3 Jade ordered lemon, which leaves Tariq the chocolate.
Clues 5 and 6 rule out the mortarboard and star for Tariq, and the diploma was on the carrot cake, so Tariq chose the owl.
Tariq's chocolate cake had the owl, so by clue 4 the star went on Jade's lemon cake.
Clue 5 keeps the mortarboard from Gus, so Gus chose the diploma and the carrot cake, and Elsa the mortarboard and coconut.
solution.epilogue: Rosa wrote the names on the boxes this time. Tariq took chocolate with an owl, Gus carrot with a diploma, Jade lemon with a star, and Elsa coconut with a mortarboard.

tip: An X carries just like a dot: whoever did not order a cake did not get its topper either.
